scripts.build: astro check && astro build && node scripts/prepare-pages-ssr.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env preview --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.db:seed:local: tsx scripts/seed-d1.ts --out .wrangler/tmp/pfseeker-seed-local.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file .wrangler/tmp/pfseeker-seed-local.sql
scripts.db:seed:preview: tsx scripts/seed-d1.ts --no-transaction --out .wrangler/tmp/pfseeker-seed-preview.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --env preview --remote --file .wrangler/tmp/pfseeker-seed-preview.sql
